    out = [row[:leftw] for row in grid]

    objects = []
    for top,bottom in bands:
        interior_h = bottom-top-1
        interior_w = leftw-2
        right = [[grid[top+i][j] for j in range(leftw+1,w-1)] for i in range(interior_h)]

            if mask==holes:
                for i,row in enumerate(holes):
                    for j,value in enumerate(row):

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    leftw = w // 2
    bg = next(v for v in grid[0] if v != 0)
    divs = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == bg for v in row[:leftw])]
    out = [row[:leftw] for row in grid]
    bands = [(a+1,b) for a,b in zip(divs,divs[1:])]
    objects = []
    for top,bottom in bands:
        interior_h = bottom-top
        interior_w = leftw-2
        right = [[grid[top+i][j] for j in range(leftw+1,w-1)] for i in range(interior_h)]
        points=[(i,j,v) for i,row in enumerate(right) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if not points: continue
        r0=min(i for i,j,v in points); r1=max(i for i,j,v in points)
        c0=min(j for i,j,v in points); c1=max(j for i,j,v in points)
        mask=[[right[i][j]!=0 for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
        color=points[0][2]
        objects.append((mask,color))
    for top,bottom in bands:
        holes=[[grid[top+i][j]==0 for j in range(1,leftw-1)] for i in range(top,bottom)]
        for mask,color in objects:
            if mask==holes:
                for i,row in enumerate(holes):
                    for j,value in enumerate(row):
                        if value: out[top+i][j+1]=color

    return out
